notes: SVS official SB-1000 Pro page (https://www.svsound.com/products/sb-1000-pro-subwoofer), exact model SB-1000 Pro (sealed; the ported PB-1000 Pro and the older SB-1000 are separate models and were not used). Frequency response 20-270 Hz +/-3 dB, specified quasi-anechoic on a 2 m ground plane (not in-room). Amplifier: Sledge STA-325D, 325 W RMS continuous, 820+ W peak dynamic (stored value is the RMS rating, amplifier_output). Driver: single 12 in long-throw woofer, 1.5 in diameter voice coil, Xmax 13.3 mm, Xmech 26.9 mm. Sealed cabinet; 342 x 330 x 375 mm (H x W x D, with grille); 11.9 kg. No sensitivity or nominal impedance published (powered subwoofer; 16 kOhm RCA / 1 kOhm speaker-level figures are amplifier input impedances, not stored as speaker impedance). The page shows a frequency-response chart image only; no underlying data points or file were available, so none were imported. No directivity file published.
